name: PAX3 (splash white)
summary: The second splash-white locus (with MITF), carrying SW2 and SW4. Same hard-edged waterline of white from below; because it is a separate gene from MITF, splash stacks on splash with no special rule. A large majority of wild horses carry one SW2 copy, so a little splash is close to the baseline look.

phenotypes.name: Splash white
phenotypes.description: Splash-type white: leg white with a clean edge, white up the belly and a bold face marking. On its own it is hard to tell from the MITF kind - the two loci make the same pattern, which is why they were long taken for one gene.

phenotypes.name: Bold splash white
phenotypes.description: White carried well up the barrel and over the face. Two copies of SW2 are viable and land here - and, like any doubled splash, deaf: the pigment cells that never reached the coat never reached the inner ear either.

conditions.name: Congenital deafness
conditions.description: Two splash copies at one locus. The pigment cells that never reached the coat never reached the inner ear either, and the horse is deaf.
